code_only_features.evidence: AgenticLoopRunner accepts calm_prefix/followup_suffix and actually delivers them to the subject: runner.py:89 injects the reassuring prefix into the system prompt and runner.py:120-121 appends followup_suffix after each (failing) tool observation. Wired and executed only in the calm-data generation path: calm_data.py:64-69 passes CALM_PROMPT_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm... You don't take it personally... That's just part of the process') and CALM_FOLLOWUP_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a fix or prove the task can't be solved from here, both are wins!'). NOTE: the main distress experiment (scripts/run_elicitation.py:61-64) constructs AgenticLoopRunner WITHOUT these, so the harmful elicitation rollouts receive no reassurance; and the agentic loop runs the full max_turns (runner.py:107) with no early exit, no distress-triggered halt, and HIGH_FRUSTRATION_THRESHOLD (config.py:125) is used only in post-hoc aggregation (aggregate.py:25, per_turn.py:29), never to stop a rollout. No consent, debrief, or aftercare exists anywhere.
